response.note: Counts orders in v_orders for merchant 'Orbit Electronics' created between 2026-10-01 and 2026-11-01.
response.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM v_orders WHERE merchant_name = 'Orbit Electronics' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' LIMIT 50
